text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Eulogy, The Influencer, The Reunion. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ Tariq follows a person, maybe 60s in — The Eulogy still stands.
🛡️ a woman, maybe 20s, with a nervous tic follows Sigrun in — The Influencer still stands.
